tasks.title: Accepted is not verified for verifier-less operations
tasks.authority_impact: none; outcome classification only, no routing, retry, mutation, or authority change
acceptance_criteria: An action with no registered verifier never reaches verified
Such an action stays executed and records that no readback verifier is registered
An explicit verifier still reaches verified and a failing verifier still reaches failed
An executed action cannot be claimed and executed a second time
The change introduces no new state, schema, or mutation path
A destructive Plan control cannot create a second request after a durable outcome for a verifier-less operation

evidence.verification: RED->GREEN 4 new tests plus 1 destructive-control guard (negative control verified); corrected 1 pre-existing verified expectation; registry audit showed 15 of 27 action types have no verifier; full suite 832 passed, 64 skipped; Ruff, git diff --check, node --check clean

tasks.title: Reconcile accounts a complete provider read no longer returns
tasks.authority_impact: none; local read-model archival only, no provider write, no routing, retry, or mutation path added
acceptance_criteria: Only a complete, error-free provider read may conclude that an account is gone
A conclusion of absence is scoped to the reading provider's own connection
An absent account keeps its row, its transactions and its transaction links; nothing is deleted
An absent account stops being a current observation and stops pinning or rescuing workspace freshness
An account the provider returns again is reactivated and its absence evidence is cleared
Absence is recorded once per observation and is not re-stamped by later reads
An unreconciled frozen account, and a connection with no observed accounts, still report stale
Account reads tolerate a database that has not yet applied migration 020

evidence.verification: RED->GREEN 12 tests in tests/meridian/test_sync_reconciliation.py plus 1 migration test pinning both account-column tolerance branches on a database stopped before 020; 7 mutation checks confirm the tests are load-bearing (no reconciliation, unguarded freshness join, no reactivation, re-stamped absence, completeness gate ignored, unconditional absence reset, untolerated account columns); full suite 845 passed, 56 skipped, 1 pre-existing playwright-unavailable failure; Ruff clean on changed paths, git diff --check clean; verified end to end on a copy of the owner's database with a live complete read-only Crew snapshot: the one pocket Crew no longer returns was archived with absent_since, its 19 historical transactions were retained, and freshness moved stale -> fresh

tasks.title: An archived account is reported with provenance, never as a current balance
tasks.authority_impact: none; read-model and presentation only, no new control, no mutation path
acceptance_criteria: An account a complete read concluded is gone is reported in the Accounts read model instead of disappearing
The report carries provenance: provider, account type, absent_since, last observation and how much history survives
No amount is exposed for an archived account, because a last known balance is not a current balance
Archived accounts never appear in the current account structure, the summary maths, or the Account filter options
The archived list is bounded and ordered by conclusion time, not row id
A database that has not applied migration 020 reports no archived accounts rather than failing
Activity labels the account each transaction belongs to and marks transactions of archived accounts
The archived surface adds no interactive control and ships collapsed when empty

evidence.verification: RED->GREEN 11 tests in tests/meridian/test_archived_accounts.py (executable label checks through node) plus 4 API/rendered-page tests in tests/meridian/test_api.py; mutations caught: ordering by row id, rendering a balance in an archived row, dropping the ledger account label; full suite 860 passed, 56 skipped, 1 pre-existing playwright-unavailable failure; Ruff, git diff --check and node --check clean; verified end to end on a copy of the owner's database with a live complete read-only Crew snapshot: 6 current accounts, 1 archived with 19 retained transactions and no amount exposed, 0 current rows wrongly archived

tasks.title: An approved Crew write is refused when the reviewed state changed (A12)
tasks.authority_impact: narrows; a stale approval no longer reaches the provider
acceptance_criteria: A proposal records the state its reviewer approved, not only the requested parameters
Execution re-checks that reviewed state after the atomic claim and before any provider call
A changed record is refused as precondition_conflict with sent_to_provider false and retry_allowed false
A missing or unreadable reviewed state refuses as precondition_unverifiable (fail closed)
A refusal is terminal and cannot be retried or silently re-run
Only update_crew_bill is guarded; every other action type behaves as before
The refusal payload records provider_truth false rather than implying a provider readback

evidence.verification: RED->GREEN 7 engine tests (tests/crew/test_executors.py) plus 4 wired tests (tests/meridian/test_crew_write_actions.py); neutralising the guard turns 5 red including the never-reaches-Crew assertion; full suite 875 passed, 56 skipped, 1 pre-existing playwright-unavailable failure; Ruff and git diff --check clean
